name: XLK vs Bitcoin Correlation Analysis
description: Analyze the correlation dynamics between the S&P 500 technology sector (XLK ETF) and Bitcoin (BTCUSD) over the past year. This study examines how these two risk assets co-move, providing insights for portfolio diversification and cross-asset trading strategies.
source:
# XLK vs Bitcoin Correlation Analysis
# Analyzing correlation dynamics between tech sector (XLK) and Bitcoin over 1 year

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# XLK (primary asset)
src_xlk = market_data_source()()
close_xlk = src_xlk.c

# Bitcoin via crypto_pairs data source
src_btc = crypto_pairs(ticker='BTCUSD')()
close_btc = src_btc.c

# ============================================================================
# DAILY RETURNS
# ============================================================================

ret_xlk = returns(period=1)(close_xlk)
ret_btc = returns(period=1)(close_btc)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING & EXPANDING CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================================

# Short-term (20-day) rolling correlation
corr_20d = rolling_corr(window=20, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_xlk, y=ret_btc)

# Medium-term (60-day) rolling correlation
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_xlk, y=ret_btc)

# Full period expanding correlation
corr_expanding = rolling_corr(window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_xlk, y=ret_btc)

# ============================================================================
# NORMALIZED PRICES (rebased to 100)
# ============================================================================

# Cumulative returns to create indexed price series
cum_ret_xlk = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + ret_xlk)
cum_ret_btc = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + ret_btc)

# Rebase to 100
norm_xlk = cum_ret_xlk * 100
norm_btc = cum_ret_btc * 100

# ============================================================================
# ANNUALIZED VOLATILITY
# ============================================================================

vol_xlk = volatility(period=20)(close_xlk)
vol_btc = volatility(period=20)(close_btc)

# ============================================================================
# CHARTS
# ============================================================================

# Index for x-axis
idx = index()()

# Chart 1: Rolling Correlation Time Series
xy_lines(
    title="Rolling Correlation: XLK vs Bitcoin",
    category="Correlation Analysis",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day Rolling", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60-Day Rolling", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Full Period (Expanding)", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="+0.5 (Moderate)"),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="-0.5 (Moderate)")
    ])
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(corr_20d, corr_60d, corr_expanding))

# Chart 2: Normalized Price Comparison
xy_lines(
    title="Normalized Price Comparison (Rebased to 100)",
    category="Price Comparison",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="Indexed Price",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="XLK (Tech Sector)", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Bitcoin", color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Starting Point")
    ])
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(norm_xlk, norm_btc))

# Chart 3: Return Distribution Scatter
xy_scatter(
    title="Return Distribution: XLK vs Bitcoin",
    category="Scatter Analysis",
    x_axis_label="XLK Daily Return",
    y_axis_label="Bitcoin Daily Return",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="Daily Returns", color=Color.Purple, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ])
)(x=ret_xlk, y_values=ret_btc)

# Chart 4: Volatility Comparison (Risk Profile)
labeled_scatter(
    title="Risk-Return Profile: XLK vs Bitcoin",
    category="Summary",
    x_axis_label="Annualized Volatility",
    y_axis_label="Cumulative Return (Indexed)",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label="XLK", color=Color.Blue, x_agg=AggregationType.Last, y_agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LabeledPointSpec(label="Bitcoin", color=Color.Orange, x_agg=AggregationType.Last, y_agg=AggregationType.Last)
    ])
)(vol_xlk, norm_xlk, vol_btc, norm_btc)

# ============================================================================
# CORRELATION HEATMAP (2x2 Matrix Visualization)
# ============================================================================

# Create correlation matrix values for heatmap
# Using month_of_year for temporal breakdown
month_num = month_of_year()()

heatmap(
    title="Monthly Correlation: XLK vs Bitcoin",
    category="Correlation Heatmap",
    x_axis_label="Month",
    y_axis_label="Correlation Window",
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    value_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    show_data_labels=True
)(x=month_num, y=1, value=corr_20d)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY CARDS
# ============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Correlation Statistics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Full Period Correlation", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean Rolling Corr (20d)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max Correlation (20d)", card_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min Correlation (20d)", card_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="XLK Volatility (Ann.)", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Bitcoin Volatility (Ann.)", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(corr_expanding, corr_20d, corr_20d, corr_20d, vol_xlk, vol_btc)
